capability.summary: Retrieve Frankfurter ECB reference rates for one currency pair
capability.description: Calls Frankfurter's fixed latest-rates endpoint with optional from/to currency codes, defaulting to USD/EUR, and returns the provider response in the shared JSON envelope. It retrieves reference rates rather than converting an amount.
capability.problem_space: Latest ECB reference-rate lookup for a named currency pair; not amount conversion, historical time-series retrieval, or investment advice.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional from currency at CLI position 1 and optional to currency at position 2. Output: shared JSON envelope containing the Frankfurter latest-rates response, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional three-letter base currency code; wrapper default is USD
optional three-letter quote currency code; wrapper default is EUR
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.frankfurter.app/latest with query from=<from or USD>&to=<to or EUR>
no amount, date, historical range, rate selection, pagination, or batch currency input; all other CLI arguments are ignored
wrapper does not locally parse, paginate, or truncate the provider result
no auth, cache, retry, or caller-selected timeout
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Frankfurter latest ECB reference rates for the requested currency pair, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: get latest ECB exchange rate for a currency pair
negative_intents: convert a monetary amount between currencies
